kjv: and have made thee a great name
mine: And I will make for you a great name
note: Hebrew we`asiti is a waw-consecutive perfect, which shifts to the future: the great name is part of the dynastic promise, not a past achievement; the KJV puts it in the past.

kjv: and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies
mine: And I will give you rest from all your enemies
note: Hebrew wahanichoti is likewise a waw-consecutive perfect continuing the promises of 7:10, so future; the KJV renders it as past.

kjv: And [is] this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?
mine: And this is instruction for mankind, Lord Yahweh!
note: Hebrew wezot torat ha'adam is obscure; it can be an exclamation ("this is a charter/instruction for humanity") or a question; the KJV's "manner of man" reads torah as custom.
